name: idea-to-spec
title: Idea → Formal NOÛS Spec (N12 Ticket)
description: Transform a raw idea into a formal NOÛS specification (N12 ticket format) with research, cross-module analysis, and validation.
author: 0-HYP004

inputs.name: idea
inputs.description: Raw idea or proposal (problem statement, vision, or feature concept)

agents.prompt:
Analyze convergence with NOÛS core modules.

Idea: {{idea}}
Title: {{idea-extractor.title}}
Related tickets: {{spec-researcher.related_tickets}}

Core NOÛS modules to check for convergence:
1. Looper (T-LOOPER-0) — triangulation graph, KeyKey indexing, navigation
2. Gates (T-GATES-0) — permission model, P-GATES protocol
3. Runner (T-RUNNER-0) — agent dispatch, subagent threading
4. Memory (T-MEMORY-0) — session state, vault archiving
5. NOS (T-NOS-0) — spec registry, tool exposure

Your task:
1. For each core module, identify 1-2 points of convergence
2. Suggest how this idea could integrate with or leverage each module
3. Flag any contradictions with existing architecture
4. Propose "KeyKey + Strate + Gravité" profile for Looper integration
5. Recommend a Livre Blanc chapter reference (format: "N.NN")

Return JSON: { "convergence": [{"module": "", "points": [], "integration_suggestion": ""}], "architecture_contradictions": [], "looper_profile": {"keykey": "", "strate": 0, "gravite_threshold": 0.8}, "livre_blanc_chapter": "" }

Draft a formal NOÛS N12 ticket specification.

Idea: {{idea}}
Title: {{idea-extractor.title}}
One-liner: {{idea-extractor.one_liner}}
Suggested ID: {{spec-researcher.suggested_ticket_id}}
Project: {{project}}
Module: {{module}}
Priority: {{priority}}
KeyKey: {{cross-analyzer.looper_profile.keykey}}
Convergence analysis: {{cross-analyzer.convergence}}
Livre Blanc: {{cross-analyzer.livre_blanc_chapter}}

Your task: Produce a complete NOÛS N12 ticket specification.

Format:
```
id: [suggested_ticket_id]
title: [clear title]
statut: draft
priorite: [priority]
projet: [project]
assignee: ""
tags: [relevant tags]
keykey: [{{cross-analyzer.looper_profile.keykey}}]
lien_lb: [{{cross-analyzer.livre_blanc_chapter}}]
parent: [[T-...-0]] (if applicable)
lien_croise: [[T-...], [T-...]] (from spec-researcher.related_tickets)

DONE-WHEN:
[List 2-3 concrete, measurable acceptance criteria]

CONTEXTE:
[2-3 sentences: why this matters, business value]

ARCHITECTURE:
[Key design decisions, module interactions, data structures]

DÉPENDANCES:
[Blocking tickets, required integrations]

DÉCISIONS:
[Open questions to resolve before implementation]
```

Return plain text (code block format).

Validate the drafted specification against NOÛS architecture principles.

Drafted spec:
{{spec-drafter}}

Validation checklist:
1. Ticket ID follows T-PROJECT-MODULE-NN format? ✓/✗
2. Title is clear and specific? ✓/✗
3. DONE-WHEN criteria are measurable? ✓/✗
4. CONTEXTE explains the "why"? ✓/✗
5. ARCHITECTURE describes module interactions? ✓/✗
6. DÉPENDANCES identifies blockers? ✓/✗
7. DÉCISIONS lists open questions? ✓/✗
8. KeyKey is indexed in Looper profile? ✓/✗
9. Related tickets are cross-referenced? ✓/✗
10. No contradictions with existing core modules? ✓/✗

Your task:
1. For each failing check, suggest a correction
2. Score coherence (1-10) — how well does this spec fit NOÛS architecture?
3. Flag any risks (architectural, scheduling, scope creep)
4. Recommend ACCEPT or ITERATE
5. If ITERATE, list required revisions

Return JSON: { "validation_checks": {"check_name": "✓|✗|?", "feedback": ""}, "coherence_score": 0-10, "risks": [], "recommendation": "ACCEPT|ITERATE", "revisions_required": [] }
